shared_elements: small stylized quadruped/animal figures in profile
row or register of repeated figures aligned horizontally
justification: Both surfaces carry small schematic animal-like figures arranged in a roughly horizontal row, and both are on weathered rock, which is the only concrete correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a deeply carved relief on an upright rectangular pillar with large, volumetric animals, bands of pattern and a bird in profile, while B is a thin linear pigment or incised drawing of tiny stick-like figures spread across a broad sloping natural rock face with no framing or registers.
